items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: The mention of Marjorie Zander is made by Evelyn Giles, not the interviewee Albert Jiles. There is no evidence in the transcript that Albert Jiles has a personal relationship with Marjorie Zander.

ctx.x: And Marjorie Zander. And Dick Allen.

So, let's see. I think we've got your birth date and all that stuff about when you got started. I wanted to get you a little more about your grandfather. What was his name? My grandfather. Frank Giles.
